close_reason: fixed: submission_matches_condition HashSets built once before submission loop
description: mod.rs:1947-1965 — submission_matches_condition allocates up to 3 fresh HashSets (identity_ids, email_ids, thread_ids) on every call, which is once per EmailSubmission object during EmailSubmission/query. The round-1 inMailboxOtherThan fix pre-builds the excluded set before the email loop, but no equivalent fix was applied to the submission filter. Fix: pre-build the sets in query_objects before the per-submission closure, mirroring top_level_excluded_set.
title: submission_matches_condition: HashSet rebuilt per-submission inside filter loop
